content.short: Financial platform for e-commerce with cards, accounts and payment integrations.
content.description: Juni is a European financial platform purpose-built for e-commerce and digital advertising businesses that operate across borders. From one account it offers multi-currency accounts, corporate cards with cashback tuned for ad spend, cross-border payments to markets such as the US and mainland China, and integrations with ad networks, payment providers, and accounting tools. Juni also provides working-capital and inventory financing to help online sellers manage cash flow between buying stock and getting paid. By unifying banking, cards, FX, and analytics around the specific needs of ecommerce operators, Juni helps digital-first businesses see profitability, control marketing spend, and reconcile revenue across the many platforms they sell and advertise on.
content.meta: Juni is a financial platform for ecommerce with multi-currency accounts and cards. Discover Juni and other Neobanks on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
